The '''Marauders''' was a gang within the larger [[White Maw]] group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] active on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Galactic War]]. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Layek Davos]] who planned to defect from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] hired the services of several Marauders to accompany him and his men to the [[Starship Graveyard (Hoth)|Starship Graveyard]].<ref name="Assault on the Starbreeze" />
